COMMON_SEQUENCE.instruction: Existing ordinary engine start transition as visible/audible sync landmark; record actual onset and settle, no custom tone or playback event
Grounded stationary engine idle; record raw wheel motion and listen for unintended rolling
Ordinary stationary throttle blip only if qualified input/restraint keeps subject stationary; otherwise NOT_TESTED, never a physics/velocity hold
Steady low-speed passage through the marked window; actual speed controls clip selection, requested throttle is not speed evidence
Steady faster passage within the route's safe admitted envelope; capture same actual speed bin in both variants
Release driving action; record continuing actual motion. Optional ordinary engine-off coast is separately marked and requires safe existing input path
Ordinary braking to complete grounded stop; listen through full dwell
Use accepted native reverse controls; compare matched absolute body/wheel speeds and raw sign with forward, without changing R settings
Rolling turn through the marked same-surface window; record left/right wheel rates, yaw and actual path
Opposite rolling turn under matched conditions
Same modest marked bump/transition; retain skid and suspension transients, no artificial damage/teleport during measurement
Grounded terminal dwell and rolling-tail check; end pass before qualified fresh reset

comparisonRules.speedWindows: Integrator selects safe low/cruise actual speed windows from baseline control and freezes them before variant comparison; no prototype three-band thresholds imposed
comparisonRules.matching: Match source/world/surface/view/listener geometry and actual speed interval. Retain unmatched passages but do not label them matched A/B
comparisonRules.playbackGain: One common Windows/game/capture/review gain; no per-clip normalization, compression or EQ hiding a difference
comparisonRules.sameSession: All bound passes in one loaded world, fresh subject at same start per pass. If adapted is unavailable, retain baseline reference only and keep GEP033 incomplete
comparisonRules.noRepeatedChores: Parent automates existing admitted drive/reset checks; Marco judges sound and only unresolved behavior, not another release driving acceptance checklist
